response_text: In 2022, about 42% of adults in Newfoundland and Labrador were classified as obese based on self-reported height and weight, and roughly 38% of youth aged 12 to 17 were overweight or obese (though that youth figure is uncertain and should be treated with caution). Chronic conditions were also common: about 27% of residents 15 and over reported arthritis, and roughly 12% reported diabetes.
